# Kick sub-actions

![Adding a sub-action: on the Actions page, click + Sub-action and search for it](../../assets/screens/actions-sub-action-picker.png)

## Add broadcaster information

Looks up your own Kick channel details and saves them as variables for the next steps. It has no settings.

**Variables it adds**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%broadcastUser%` | Your Kick name |
| `%broadcastUserId%` | Your Kick ID number |
| `%broadcasterChannelSlug%` | Your channel's web name |
| `%broadcasterIsLive%` | True if you are live |
| `%broadcasterTitle%` | Your stream title |
| `%broadcasterCategory%` | Your category |
| `%broadcasterViewerCount%` | How many people watch |
| `%botUser%` | Your bot account's name |

<small>Type id: `kick.addBroadcasterInfo`</small>

## Add random users

Picks random viewers from the people who chatted lately and saves them as variables. Great for "pick a random viewer" commands.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **How many** | How many people to pick. Example: 3. Starts as: `1`. |
| **Leave out the broadcaster and the bot** | Tick to never pick you or your bot account. Starts as: `true`. |
| **Leave out the triggering user** | Tick to never pick the person who started this action. Starts as: `false`. |
| **Variable name start** | A word put in front of the variable names. Empty uses "randomUser", which gives %randomUser0%, %randomUser1% and so on. Starts as: `randomUser`. |

**Variables it adds**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%randomUser0%` | Name of the first person picked (then randomUser1, randomUser2...) |
| `%randomUserId0%` | Their Kick ID number |
| `%randomUserCount%` | How many people were found |
| `%randomUserFound%` | True if at least one person was found |

<small>Type id: `kick.addRandomUsers`</small>

## Add user to group

Puts a Kick user into one of your groups (saved lists of people). Groups are shared with the rest of Cuebot.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Group** | The name of the group (a saved list of people), like "VIPs". |
| **User** | The Kick user name, like "SomeViewer", or their Kick number ID. Leave the default to use the person who started this action. Starts as: `%userName%`. |
| **User id** | Kick number ID of the user. If it is filled in, Cuebot uses it first and only falls back to the name when it is empty. Starts as: `%userId%`. |
| **Create the group if missing** | Tick to make the group if it does not exist yet. Untick to get an error instead. Starts as: `true`. |

**Variables it adds**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%groupUserAdded%` | True if the person was added (false if they were already in) |

<small>Type id: `kick.addUserToGroup`</small>

## Ban user

Bans someone from your Kick chat for good.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **User** | The Kick user name, like "SomeViewer", or their Kick number ID. Leave the default to use the person who started this action. Starts as: `%userName%`. |
| **Reason** | Why they are banned (optional). It can be shown to moderators. |

**Variables it adds**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%bannedUser%` | Name of the banned person |
| `%bannedUserId%` | Their Kick ID number |
| `%banResult%` | True when it worked |

<small>Type id: `kick.banUser`</small>

## Configure rewards

Turns many Kick rewards on, off, paused or resumed in one go. Great for "stream mode" and "BRB mode". Only works on rewards made by Cuebot.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Enable** | Rewards to turn on. One per line: a reward title, ID or group name. |
| **Disable** | Rewards to turn off. One per line: a reward title, ID or group name. |
| **Pause** | Rewards to pause (viewers cannot use them for now). One per line: title, ID or group name. |
| **Unpause** | Rewards to resume after a pause. One per line: title, ID or group name. |
| **Disable rewards that are in no group** | Tick to also turn off every reward that is in no group and not named above. Starts as: `false`. |

**Variables it adds**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%rewardsChanged%` | How many rewards were changed |
| `%rewardsSkipped%` | How many Kick refused to change |

<small>Type id: `kick.configureRewards`</small>

## Delete chat message

Deletes one message from your Kick chat. Good for removing spam from a command or trigger.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Message id** | ID of the message to delete. The default is the message that started this action. Starts as: `%messageId%`. |

<small>Type id: `kick.deleteMessage`</small>

## Find live streams (livestreamCount, livestream1UserName, livestreamNames...)

Finds Kick streams that are live right now, the most watched first. Handy for picking someone to host after your stream.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Category** | Only streams in this category: its name, like "Just Chatting", or its number. Leave empty for every category. |
| **Language code** | Only streams in this language, as a short code like en or es. Leave empty for every language. |
| **How many** | How many streams to get, from 1 to 100. Starts as: `5`. |

**Variables it adds**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%livestreamCount%` | How many streams were found |
| `%livestreamNames%` | Their names, separated by commas |
| `%livestream1IsLive%` | True if the first one is live right now |
| `%livestream1UserName%` | The first one's name |
| `%livestream1UserId%` | The first one's Kick ID number |
| `%livestream1Slug%` | The first one's channel's web name |
| `%livestream1Url%` | Web link to the first one's channel |
| `%livestream1Title%` | The first one's stream title |
| `%livestream1Category%` | What they play |
| `%livestream1ViewerCount%` | How many people are watching |
| `%livestream1StartedAt%` | When the stream started |
| `%livestream1Thumbnail%` | Web link to a picture of the stream |

<small>Type id: `kick.getLivestreams`</small>

## Get ad status (adsOptedIn, remainingAdBreaks, maxAdBreaks...)

Asks Kick about ads on your channel: whether you are enrolled, how many ad breaks are left and how the last one went.

**Variables it adds**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%adsOptedIn%` | True if your channel is enrolled in Kick ads |
| `%adsBlocked%` | True if ads cannot run right now |
| `%autoAdsActive%` | True if Kick runs ads by itself |
| `%remainingAdBreaks%` | How many ad breaks you have left |
| `%maxAdBreaks%` | How many ad breaks you may run per period |
| `%adLimitPeriodSeconds%` | How long that period is, in seconds |
| `%lastAdBreakStatus%` | What happened to the last ad break |
| `%lastAdBreakLength%` | How long the last ad break was, in seconds |
| `%lastAdBreakAt%` | When the last ad break started |

<small>Type id: `kick.getAdStatus`</small>

## Get channel info (channelTitle, channelIsLive, channelSubscriberCount...)

Reads a Kick channel, yours or someone else's, and saves its details as variables for the next steps.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Channel** | A Kick user name, channel name or number ID. Leave empty for your own channel. |
| **Variable name start** | A word put in front of the variable names. With "channel" you get %channelTitle% and %channelIsLive%. Empty uses "channel". Starts as: `channel`. |

**Variables it adds**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%channelSlug%` | The channel's web name |
| `%channelUserId%` | The owner's Kick ID number |
| `%channelTitle%` | The stream title |
| `%channelDescription%` | The channel description |
| `%channelCategory%` | What they play |
| `%channelIsLive%` | True if they are live |
| `%channelViewerCount%` | How many people are watching |
| `%channelLanguage%` | The stream's language, like en |
| `%channelIsMature%` | True if marked for adults |
| `%channelTags%` | The stream tags, separated by commas |
| `%channelBannerPicture%` | Web link to the channel banner |
| `%channelUrl%` | Web link to the channel |
| `%channelSubscriberCount%` | Your active subscribers, gifted ones included (your own channel only) |
| `%channelGiftedSubscriberCount%` | Your active gifted subscribers (your own channel only) |
| `%channelPaidSubscriberCount%` | Your active subscribers who paid themselves (your own channel only) |
| `%channelCanceledSubscriberCount%` | Subscriptions that were cancelled but have not run out yet (your own channel only) |

<small>Type id: `kick.getChannelInfo`</small>

## Get KICKs leaderboard (leaderboardCount, leaderboard1User, leaderboard1Amount...)

Reads who gifted your channel the most KICKs this week, this month or of all time. Handy for a top gifters list.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Period** | Which list: this week, this month or all time. Options: This week, This month, All time. Starts as: `This week`. |
| **How many** | How many people to get, from 1 to 100. Starts as: `10`. |

**Variables it adds**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%leaderboardCount%` | How many people are on the list |
| `%leaderboardList%` | Everyone on the list with their amount, like "Alex (500), Sam (300)" |
| `%leaderboard1User%` | Name of the person in first place (leaderboard2User is second, and so on) |
| `%leaderboard1UserId%` | Their Kick ID number |
| `%leaderboard1Amount%` | How many KICKs they gave |
| `%leaderboard1Rank%` | Their place on the list |

<small>Type id: `kick.getKicksLeaderboard`</small>

## Get subscriber count (subscriberCount, giftedSubscriberCount, paidSubscriberCount)

Asks Kick how many subscribers your channel has right now. Handy for a sub goal or a !subs command.

**Variables it adds**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%subscriberCount%` | Active subscribers, gifted ones included |
| `%giftedSubscriberCount%` | Active gifted subscribers |
| `%paidSubscriberCount%` | Active subscribers who paid themselves |
| `%canceledSubscriberCount%` | Cancelled subscriptions that have not run out yet |

<small>Type id: `kick.getSubscriberCount`</small>

## Is a user live? (liveIsLive, liveTitle, liveViewerCount, liveCategory...)

Checks whether a Kick user is live right now and saves their stream's details. Handy for a shout-out that says what they are playing.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **User to check** | The Kick user name, like "SomeStreamer", or their Kick number ID. Leave the default to check the person who started this action. Starts as: `%userName%`. |
| **Variable name start** | A word put in front of the variable names. With "live" you get %liveIsLive% and %liveTitle%. Empty uses "live". Starts as: `live`. |

**Variables it adds**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%liveIsLive%` | True if they are live right now |
| `%liveUserName%` | Their name |
| `%liveUserId%` | Their Kick ID number |
| `%liveSlug%` | Their channel's web name |
| `%liveUrl%` | Web link to their channel |
| `%liveTitle%` | Their stream title |
| `%liveCategory%` | What they play |
| `%liveViewerCount%` | How many people are watching |
| `%liveStartedAt%` | When the stream started |
| `%liveThumbnail%` | Web link to a picture of the stream |

<small>Type id: `kick.getLiveStatus`</small>

## Look up a Kick user

Looks up another Kick user and saves their details as variables for the next steps. Handy for a shout-out command.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Target user** | The Kick user name, like "SomeViewer", or their Kick number ID. Leave the default to look up the person who started this action. Starts as: `%userName%`. |
| **Variable name start** | A word put in front of the variable names. With "target" you get %targetUserName% and %targetStreamTitle%. Empty uses "target". Starts as: `target`. |

**Variables it adds**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%targetUserName%` | Their name |
| `%targetUserId%` | Their Kick ID number |
| `%targetProfilePicture%` | Web link to their picture |
| `%targetChannelSlug%` | Their channel's web name |
| `%targetIsLive%` | True if they are live |
| `%targetStreamTitle%` | Their stream title |
| `%targetCategory%` | What they play |
| `%targetDescription%` | Their channel description |

<small>Type id: `kick.getUserInfo`</small>

Ends someone's timeout in your Kick chat so they can write again.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **User** | The Kick user name, like "SomeViewer", or their Kick number ID. Leave the default to use the person who started this action. Starts as: `%userName%`. |

**Variables it adds**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%unTimedOutUser%` | Name of the person |
| `%unTimedOutUserId%` | Their Kick ID number |
| `%unTimedOutResult%` | True when it worked |

<small>Type id: `kick.untimeoutUser`</small>

## Remove user from group

Takes a Kick user out of one of your groups (saved lists of people).

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Group** | The name of the group (a saved list of people), like "VIPs". |
| **User** | The Kick user name, like "SomeViewer", or their Kick number ID. Leave the default to use the person who started this action. Starts as: `%userName%`. |
| **User id** | Kick number ID of the user. If it is filled in, Cuebot uses it first and only falls back to the name when it is empty. Starts as: `%userId%`. |

**Variables it adds**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%groupUserRemoved%` | True if the person was in the group and is removed |

## Reply to message

Writes a reply to one message in your Kick chat, shown under that message.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Message** | What to write, like "Thanks for asking!". |
| **Message id to reply to** | ID of the message to reply to. The default is the message that started this action. Starts as: `%messageId%`. |
| **Send as bot account** | Tick to write as your bot account instead of your own account. The bot must be signed in on the Kick page. Starts as: `false`. |
| **Use the broadcaster when the bot is not signed in** | Tick to write as you if the bot account is not signed in. Untick to get an error instead. Starts as: `true`. |

**Variables it adds**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%kickMessageId%` | ID of the reply Cuebot just sent |

<small>Type id: `kick.replyToMessage`</small>

## Reward group: set enabled state

Turns every reward in a reward group on or off. Only works on rewards made by Cuebot.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Reward group** | The reward group's name. You set a reward's group on the Kick page, under Channel rewards. |
| **State** | "Enabled" turns them on, "Disabled" turns them off, "Toggle" flips them (all on, unless one is already on). Options: Enabled, Disabled, Toggle. Starts as: `Enabled`. |

**Variables it adds**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%rewardsChanged%` | How many rewards were changed |
| `%rewardsSkipped%` | How many Kick refused to change |

<small>Type id: `kick.setRewardGroupEnabled`</small>

## Reward group: set paused state

Pauses or resumes every reward in a reward group. Only works on rewards made by Cuebot.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Reward group** | The reward group's name. You set a reward's group on the Kick page, under Channel rewards. |
| **State** | "Paused" pauses them, "Unpaused" resumes them, "Toggle" flips them (all paused, unless one is already paused). Options: Paused, Unpaused, Toggle. Starts as: `Paused`. |

**Variables it adds**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%rewardsChanged%` | How many rewards were changed |
| `%rewardsSkipped%` | How many Kick refused to change |

<small>Type id: `kick.setRewardGroupPaused`</small>

## Reward: accept or reject all pending redemptions

Accepts or rejects all redemptions that are still waiting, for one reward or for all rewards Cuebot manages. Rejecting gives the points back.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Reward** | The reward's title or ID. Leave empty for every reward. |
| **Action** | "Accept" marks them done. "Reject" refuses them (the viewers get their points back). Options: Accept, Reject. Starts as: `Accept`. |

**Variables it adds**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%redemptionsUpdated%` | How many redemptions were handled |
| `%redemptionFailures%` | Which ones failed and why |

<small>Type id: `kick.updatePendingRedemptions`</small>

## Reward: accept or reject redemption

Accepts or rejects one reward redemption that is waiting. Handy to accept it after your action did its job.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Redemption id** | ID of the redemption. The default is the one that started this action. You can give several, separated by commas. Starts as: `%redemptionId%`. |
| **Action** | "Accept" marks it done. "Reject" refuses it (the viewer gets their points back). Options: Accept, Reject. Starts as: `Accept`. |

**Variables it adds**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%redemptionUpdated%` | True if it worked for every redemption |
| `%redemptionFailures%` | Which ones failed and why |

<small>Type id: `kick.updateRedemption`</small>

## Reward: create

Makes a new channel reward on Kick. You can change or delete it later with Cuebot.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Title** | The reward name viewers see, like "Hydrate!". Up to 50 letters. |
| **Cost** | How many channel points it costs. Example: 100. Starts as: `100`. |
| **Description** | A short text under the name (optional). Up to 200 letters. |
| **Background colour (#RRGGBB)** | The reward color as #RRGGBB, like "#00E701" (Kick green). Empty keeps the default. Starts as: `#00E701`. |
| **Enabled** | Tick to let viewers use it right away. Starts as: `true`. |
| **Viewer must enter text** | Tick to make the viewer type a text when they redeem it. Starts as: `false`. |
| **Skip the request queue (accept automatically)** | Tick to accept redemptions automatically, without waiting for you. Starts as: `false`. |

**Variables it adds**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%createdRewardId%` | ID of the new reward |
| `%createdRewardTitle%` | Title of the new reward |

<small>Type id: `kick.createReward`</small>

## Reward: delete

Deletes a Kick channel reward for good. Only works on rewards made by Cuebot.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Reward** | The reward's title or ID. Leave empty to use the reward that was just redeemed (when this runs from a Kick reward trigger). |

<small>Type id: `kick.deleteReward`</small>

## Reward: get counters (counter, userCounter)

Reads how many times a reward was redeemed (Cuebot keeps this count, Kick does not) and saves it as variables.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Reward** | The reward's title or ID. Leave empty to use the reward that was just redeemed (when this runs from a Kick reward trigger). |
| **For user** | Whose personal count to read: a Kick user name or ID. The default is the person who started this action. Empty gives no personal count. Starts as: `%userId%`. |

**Variables it adds**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%counter%` | How many times the reward was redeemed |
| `%userCounter%` | How many times this person redeemed it |

<small>Type id: `kick.getRewardCounter`</small>

## Reward: get info

Reads a reward's settings from Kick and saves them as variables for the next steps.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Reward** | The reward's title or ID. Leave empty to use the reward that was just redeemed (when this runs from a Kick reward trigger). |

**Variables it adds**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%rewardId%` | ID of the reward |
| `%rewardTitle%` | Its title |
| `%rewardDescription%` | Its description |
| `%rewardCost%` | Its cost |
| `%rewardBackgroundColor%` | Its color |
| `%rewardEnabled%` | True if it is turned on |
| `%rewardPaused%` | True if it is paused |
| `%rewardUserInputRequired%` | True if viewers must type a text |
| `%rewardSkipsQueue%` | True if redemptions are accepted automatically |

<small>Type id: `kick.getRewardInfo`</small>

Writes a message in your Kick chat. You can use variables like %user% in the text.

| **Message** | What to write, like "Welcome in, %user%!". Very long messages are cut into several messages. |
| **Send as bot account** | Tick to write as your bot account instead of your own account. The bot must be signed in on the Kick page. Starts as: `false`. |
| **Use the broadcaster when the bot is not signed in** | Tick to write as you if the bot account is not signed in. Untick to get an error instead. Starts as: `true`. |

**Variables it adds**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%kickMessageId%` | ID of the message Cuebot just sent |

<small>Type id: `kick.sendMessage`</small>

## Set channel category (kickCategory, category.id, category.name, category.success)

Changes your Kick stream category (the game or topic).

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Category** | The category name, like "Just Chatting", or its Kick number ID. A name is searched on Kick and the best match is used. |

**Variables it adds**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%kickCategory%` | Name of the category that was set |
| `%kickCategoryId%` | Kick ID of that category |
| `%category.success%` | True when the category was changed |

<small>Type id: `kick.setCategory`</small>

## Set channel tags (tags)

Changes the tags of your Kick stream, the short words viewers see under it, like "chill" or "english".

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Tags** | The tags, separated by commas, like "chill, english, cozy". Leave empty to remove every tag. |

**Variables it adds**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%tags%` | The tags that were set |
| `%tagsSuccess%` | True when Kick took the tags |

<small>Type id: `kick.setTags`</small>

## Set channel title

Changes your Kick stream title.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Title** | The new title, like "Playing with viewers!". It cannot be empty. |

**Variables it adds**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%titleSuccess%` | True when the title was changed |

<small>Type id: `kick.setTitle`</small>

## Timeout user

Gives someone a timeout in your Kick chat. They cannot write for a while.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **User** | The Kick user name, like "SomeViewer", or their Kick number ID. Leave the default to use the person who started this action. Starts as: `%userName%`. |
| **Duration (seconds)** | How long, in seconds. Kick uses whole minutes, so it is rounded up (30 becomes 1 minute). The most is 7 days. Example: 300 for 5 minutes. Starts as: `300`. |
| **Reason** | Why they get a timeout (optional). |

**Variables it adds**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%timedOutUser%` | Name of the person |
| `%timedOutUserId%` | Their Kick ID number |
| `%timeoutResult%` | True when it worked |

<small>Type id: `kick.timeoutUser`</small>

## Unban user

Lifts a ban from someone in your Kick chat.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **User** | The Kick user name, like "SomeViewer", or their Kick number ID. Leave the default to use the person who started this action. Starts as: `%userName%`. |

**Variables it adds**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%unbannedUser%` | Name of the person |
| `%unbannedUserId%` | Their Kick ID number |
| `%unbanResult%` | True when it worked |

<small>Type id: `kick.unbanUser`</small>

## User in group

Checks if a Kick user is in one of your groups. Cuebot then follows the True or False path below this step.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Group** | The name of the group (a saved list of people), like "VIPs". |
| **User** | The Kick user name, like "SomeViewer", or their Kick number ID. Leave the default to use the person who started this action. Starts as: `%userName%`. |
| **User id** | Kick number ID of the user. If it is filled in, Cuebot uses it first and only falls back to the name when it is empty. Starts as: `%userId%`. |
| **Save the answer in variable** | The variable name to save the answer in. Example: "inGroup" lets you use %inGroup% later. Starts as: `inGroup`. |

Paths it can take: **True**, **False**.

**Variables it adds**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%inGroup%` | True if the person is in the group (or the name you chose above) |

<small>Type id: `kick.userInGroup`</small>
